blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these terms have a coefficient of negative one? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the terms whose coefficient is −1.

blocks.text: Negative x. No number is written, so the coefficient is one, and the minus sign makes it negative one. Yes.
x. The coefficient is positive one, because there is no minus sign. No.
Negative four x. The coefficient is negative four, not negative one. No.
Negative y squared. The coefficient is hidden. It is one, with the minus sign, negative one. Yes.
Negative the quantity x plus two. The minus sign in front of the group means negative one times the group. The coefficient is negative one. Yes.
Three of them have a coefficient of negative one: negative x, negative y squared, and the negative group. A minus sign with no number means negative one.
